name: brains
description: Fine-tuned model tracker and trainer — wraps OpenAI and Thinker Labs, gathers training data from todos/mementos/conversations/sessions. Ships a CLI, an MCP server, and a REST API over a local SQLite store, or PostgreSQL selected by HASNA_BRAINS_DATABASE_URL.

serviceSurfaces.name: brains-api
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: brains-serve exposes a local REST surface only. It implements GET /health but not GET /ready, GET /version, a /v1 base path, or an OpenAPI document, so declaring the API supported would assert a topology the server does not have.

serviceSurfaces.name: brains-sdk
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: No client SDK is generated while the HTTP API surface is deferred; consumers import ./src/index.ts directly.
